description.zh: 聚合计算定义。
description.en: The aggregate function definitions.

description.zh: 聚合计算别名。N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The alias of the aggregate function. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh: 聚合计算原始的字段名称。N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The name of the original field for aggregation. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh:
在计算周期内根据选定的统计方法对日志数据进行聚合处理。N的取值范围：1~10。取值：
- count：计数。
- sum：求和。
- avg：平均值。
- max：最大值。
- min：最小值。
- countps：计算统计周期内指定字段求count后的每秒平均值。
- sumps：计算统计周期内指定字段求sum后的每秒平均值。
- distinct：去重后计算统计周期内指定字段出现的次数。
description.en:
The statistical method used to aggregate log data within a statistical period. Valid values of N: 1 to 10. Valid values:
- count: counts the number of occurrences.
- sum: calculates the sum.
- avg: calculates the average.
- max: returns the maximum value.
- min: returns the minimum value.
- countps: calculates the average count per second for the specified field within the statistical period.
- sumps: calculates the average sum per second for the specified field within the statistical period.
- distinct: counts the number of occurrences of the specified field after deduplication within the statistical period.

description.zh: 应用分组ID。
description.en: The ID of the application group.

description.zh: 对数据进行空间维度聚合。相当于SQL中的Group By，根据指定的维度，对监控数据进行分组。如果Group By不选择任何维度，则根据聚合方法对全部监控数据进行聚合。
description.en: The dimensions used for spatial aggregation. This is equivalent to the Group By clause in SQL, which groups monitoring data by specified dimensions. If no dimension is specified, all monitoring data is aggregated based on the aggregate function.

description.zh: GroupBy别名。N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The alias of the Group By field. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh: GroupBy字段名称。N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The name of the Group By field. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh: 日志监控ID。
description.en: The ID of the log monitoring metric.

description.zh:
扩展字段。 扩展字段为统计方法中的结果提供四则运算的功能。

例如：在统计方法中配置了HTTP状态码请求总数TotalNumber和HTTP状态码大于499的请求数5xxNumber，则可以通过扩展字段计算出服务端的错误率：5xxNumber/TotalNumber*100。

JSON格式：{"extend":{"errorPercent":"5xxNumber/TotalNumber*100"}}。字段说明如下：

- extend：必填字段。

- errorPercent：计算结果生成新字段的别名，您可以根据真实情况自行命名。 

- errorPercent：现有字段的计算表达式。
description.en:
The extended field. The extended field provides arithmetic operations on the results of the statistical methods.

For example, if you configure the total number of HTTP status code requests (TotalNumber) and the number of requests with HTTP status codes greater than 499 (5xxNumber) in the statistical methods, you can use the extended field to calculate the server error rate: 5xxNumber/TotalNumber*100.

JSON format: {"extend":{"errorPercent":"5xxNumber/TotalNumber*100"}}. Field description:

- extend: required.

- errorPercent: the alias of the new field generated from the calculation result. You can specify a custom name. 

- errorPercent: the calculation expression for existing fields.

description.zh: 监控项名称。关于云监控支持云服务的监控项，请参见[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en: The metric name. For information about the metrics supported by CloudMonitor for Alibaba Cloud services, see [Cloud service monitoring metrics](~~163515~~).

description.zh: 日志服务中日志库的名称。
description.en: The name of the Log Service Logstore.

description.zh: 日志服务中日志项目的名称。
description.en: The name of the Log Service project.

description.zh: 日志服务中日志项目（Project）所在地域。
description.en: The region where the Log Service project resides.

description.zh: 预计算窗口时间。单位：秒。云监控将在定义的预计算时间对数据做一次聚合计算。
description.en: The tumbling window size for pre-aggregation. Unit: seconds. CloudMonitor performs an aggregation calculation on the data at the specified interval.

description.zh: 单位。
description.en: The unit.

description.zh: 筛选的过滤规则，配合ValueFilterRelation使用。相当于SQL中的Where条件。如果不填写，则表示对全部数据进行处理。例如：日志中有Level和Error字段，如果需要统计每分钟Error出现的次数，则统计方法可以定义为对Level求和，并且Level=Error。
description.en: The filter rules, used together with ValueFilterRelation. This is equivalent to the Where clause in SQL. If this parameter is not specified, all data is processed. For example, if the log contains Level and Error fields and you want to count the number of Error occurrences per minute, you can define the statistical method to sum the Level field with the condition Level=Error.

description.zh: 日志匹配的字段名名称。N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The name of the log field to match. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh:
字段值的匹配方式。N的取值范围：1~10。取值：
- `contain`：包含。
- `notContain`：不包含。
- `>`：大于。
- `<`：小于。
- `>=`：大于等于。
- `<=`：小于等于。
description.en:
The matching method for the field value. Valid values of N: 1 to 10. Valid values:
- `contain`: contains.
- `notContain`: does not contain.
- `>`: greater than.
- `<`: less than.
- `>=`: greater than or equal to.
- `<=`: less than or equal to.

description.zh: 日志匹配的字段值。N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The value of the log field to match. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh:
日志筛选的过滤条件。取值：

- and：和。

- or：或。

> 本参数需要与`ValueFilter.N.Key`配合使用。
description.en:
The logical operator used to combine log filter conditions. Valid values:

- and

- or

> This parameter must be used together with `ValueFilter.N.Key`.

title.en: Create or modify a log monitoring metric

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，创建一个日志监控`cpu_total`。返回结果显示，创建日志监控成功，日志监控ID为`16****`。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example of how to create a log monitoring metric named `cpu_total`. The response shows that the log monitoring metric is created. The log monitoring metric ID is `16****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms put-log-monitor --log-id 160000 --sls-region-id cn-hangzhou --sls-project test-project --sls-logstore test-logstore --metric-name cpu_total --metric-express extend_:_errorPercent_:_5XXNumber/TotalNumber0100 --group-id 73010000 --value-filter-relation and --tumblingwindows 60,300 --unit Percent --aggregates Function=count Alias=Count FieldName=sourceCount --groupbys Alias=CPUUtilization FieldName=cpu --value-filter Operator=contain Value=test Key=lh_source --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutLogMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --SlsProject 'test-project' --Aggregates.1.FieldName sourceCount --Tumblingwindows '60,300' --Aggregates.1.Function count --ValueFilter.1.Key lh_source --Unit Percent --Aggregates.1.Alias Count --SlsLogstore 'test-logstore' --MetricExpress 'extend_:_errorPercent_:_5XXNumber/TotalNumber0100' --ValueFilter.1.Value test --GroupId 73010000 --MetricName cpu_total --Groupbys.1.FieldName cpu --ValueFilter.1.Operator contain --ValueFilterRelation and --LogId 160000 --SlsRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Groupbys.1.Alias CPUUtilization
